about: Mission profiles. Link rates: Mars uses a 1/d^2 model anchored to published MRO figures with 10% reserved for medicine (placeholder). ISS/Moon rates are team placeholders.

profiles.name: Lunar orbit / transit (Artemis, Gateway)
profiles.notes: Seconds of delay: enough to make live conversation harder.

profiles.name: Lunar south pole (with relay)
profiles.evacuation: Up to ~14 days stabilising on board
profiles.notes: Relay satellites give a continuous link.

profiles.name: Lunar south pole (no relay)
profiles.evacuation: Up to ~14 days stabilising on board
profiles.notes: Without relay satellites Earth is visible only half of each sidereal month (27.32 d). Team model: visibility phase anchored at launch.

profiles.name: Mars transit
profiles.notes: 0-22 min each way; weeks with no link during solar conjunction.
profiles.radiation_ref: About 1.8 mSv/day measured in transit to Mars (Zeitlin 2013)

profiles.name: Mars surface
profiles.notes: Same delay as transit. Partial-gravity references are not well known yet.
